messages:
maria: Hey folks — quick sync: I'd like to run a small deprecation rollup for legacy terms in the glossary (e.g., "model family" -> "model family alias", "prompting" vs "prompt engineering"). Goal: single PR that lists deprecated terms, replacement proposals, and migration notes for SDK snippets. Can volunteers take ownership?

alex: I'm +1. We should lock down the canonical mapping first. Have a short CSV mapping: old_term, new_term, rationale, urgency.

jonah: I can run a repo grep to find instances in docs + sdk snippets. Will post a list by EOD. Suggest we add a `deprecated` badge in the glossary entries and a note: "will be removed in Q2".

sasha: For SDK snippets we'll need examples for both old and new patterns during the transition. Example: replace `client.generate(...)` snippets with `client.responses.create()`? Need exact API names.

maria: Good call. Let's make an action checklist:
1) canonical mapping CSV
2) regex search & frequency table
3) glossary badges + deprecation copy
4) docs PR template & changelog blurb
5) SDK snippet migration PRs (code + tests)
6) coord with eng for redirect-friendly URLs

elaine: I'll take item 3 (glossary badges) and draft the copy. Suggested copy: "Deprecated: use <new-term>. See migration notes."

jonah: Sharing initial grep output: `grep -R --line-number "prompting\|model family" docs/ sdk/ | head -n 25` — lots in examples and one old tutorial. I'll put full CSV in the thread when done.

doc-bot: Reminder: Please add the `docs-deprecations` label to any PR touching glossary or public snippets.

alex: Timeline: let's target a lightweight announcement next Wednesday, full sweep PRs by next Friday. Is that OK?

maria: Works for me. We'll triage high-visibility pages first (Getting Started, SDK Quickstart, API reference). Jonah — can you prioritize those when scanning?

jonah: Yup. Prioritizing.

sasha: Will prepare example snippets for both JS and Python. One question: should we keep the old snippet behind a `<!-- legacy -->` HTML comment or remove entirely?

maria: Keep legacy snippet for 2 weeks behind a clear banner (`Deprecated — will be removed on <date>`). That gives time for customers.

elaine: Draft badge text posted: `Deprecated — replaced by <new-term> (migration guide)` — proposing color `#D5532A` to match warning tone.

alex: Small nit: add a section in the migration guide about semantic differences when replacing terms (e.g., "prompting" -> "prompt engineering" implies process-oriented docs). We shouldn't just string-replace without verification.

maria: Agree. We'll do manual spot-checks for context-sensitive terms.

jonah: Uploaded CSV to Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/deprecation-csv — includes counts and locations. Will open PR with the high-visibility fixes tomorrow.

sasha: Thanks. I'll start on snippet PRs once Jonah's locations land.

maria: Perfect. Assigning roles: Jonah (grep + PRs), Elaine (glossary badges copy + CSS), Sasha (snippet PRs), Alex (announce + migration blurb). I'll shepherd the docs PRs. :thumbsup:

alex: 👍

elaine: 👍

jonah: starting now.

maria: Closing the loop — please add your PR numbers here when created so I can assemble the rollup changelog. Thanks all!
